_comment: Golden fixture for DE-SYMPH-001 nested condition-block validation. Input shapes are hand-built malformed nested dicts (constructors cannot emit invalid ones). Expected outputs are HARD error markers — not exact strings, just non-empty list assertions. The valid_any_gate shape is the v2 grammar §7.3 corpus-verified real ANY example built with make_compound_condition / make_binary_compound_condition constructors.

valid_any_gate_corpus_s7_3._source: feature-plans/strategy-builder-composer-grammar-v2.md §7.3 (VERIFIED-CORPUS) — top-level compound operator=any with 1 binary + 4 binary-compound sub-conditions

malformed_nested_unknown_condition_type._source: Hand-built for AC-1: a valid compound top-level wrapping a sub-block with unknown condition-type 'xor'. Constructors cannot emit this — built manually to exercise the missing recursion in _validate_condition_block.

malformed_nested_bad_operator._source: Hand-built for AC-2: valid compound top-level wrapping a nested binary-compound with operator='xor' (not any/all). Exercises the nested operator check.
malformed_nested_bad_operator._expected: validate_tree returns >= 1 HARD error mentioning bad operator

malformed_nested_compound_missing_condit._source: Hand-built for AC-3a: valid compound top-level wrapping a nested compound missing the 'conditions' key.
malformed_nested_compound_missing_condit._expected: validate_tree returns >= 1 HARD error mentioning missing conditions

malformed_nested_binary_compound_missing._source: Hand-built for AC-3b: valid compound top-level wrapping a nested binary-compound missing the 'tickers' key.
malformed_nested_binary_compound_missing._expected: validate_tree returns >= 1 HARD error mentioning missing tickers

malformed_deeply_nested_bad_binary_compo._source: Hand-built for AC-4: compound -> compound -> binary-compound with operator='xor'. The malformed block is two levels deep — tests that recursion reaches depth-2.
malformed_deeply_nested_bad_binary_compo._expected: validate_tree returns >= 1 HARD error (catches the xor operator at depth 2)
